Test.effect_when_absent: pre-commit falls back to the Gate, which mints the artifact -- commit and merge are one run; declaring Test adds a second run per commit
Test.none_meaning: not declared -- hooks/pre-commit-test.sh treats the literal value `none` (case-insensitive, trimmed) as absent and falls through to the Gate (fixed since v3.0.3; before that it was eval'd as a command and blocked every commit)

Gate-checked branches.effect_when_absent: no branch gets the artifact-freshness-only merge lane; every branch is either protected or fully ungated
Gate-checked branches.none_meaning: no branch is gate-checked -- hooks/lib/git-cmd.sh's gc_gate_checked_branches reads it as an empty branch list, same as absent; DO NOT read `none` here as widening access

Post-edit build.effect_when_absent: hooks/post-edit-build.sh is inert -- no build runs after Edit/Write
Post-edit build.none_meaning: no-op -- hooks/post-edit-build.sh treats `none` exactly like absent

PO write surface.effect_when_absent: the PO's write surface stays at the template default (docs/plans, PROJECT_STATE.md, PROJECT_CONTEXT.md, .claude/, CLAUDE.md, AGENT_TEAM.md)
PO write surface.none_meaning: the template default -- no extra prefixes are added

Test (frontend).effect_when_absent: no separate frontend test step runs; the Gate/Test above is the only automated check

Log location.effect_when_absent: purely documentation -- no hook or agent reads this key mechanically

Log Path.effect_when_absent: purely documentation -- no hook or agent reads this key mechanically
